from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialExpenseRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial expense data from a single document."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the document")
    financial_expense_amount: float | None = Field(description="The financial expense amount as a numeric value from the financial report")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    source_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label as written, e.g., '财务费用'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_expense_records: list[FinancialExpenseRecord]
